senses.gloss:
UP TO:
(1) by comp. with आ,
lord of the
earth up to the ocean:
आसमुद्रक्षितीशाः;
working
up to fructification:
आफलोदयकर्मन् (mfn.), R. i.
5.;
(3) पर्यन्तः in comp.,
from brother up to
husband:
भ्रात्रादिभर्तृपर्यन्त (f. न्ता), D. 72.;
(3) यावत् (with acc.: rare), up to marriage:
परिणयनं यावत्, D. 77.
